WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, (s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS web_nodispatch
    FROM lines f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, false
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
q AS (SELECT n.store_id, sum(n.net_sales) mine, sum(CASE WHEN web_nodispatch THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodisp
      FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
      WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1),
c AS (SELECT r.store_id, sum(r.net_sales) ctrl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
      WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(q.store_id,c.store_id) sid, q.mine, c.ctrl, round(q.mine-c.ctrl,2) diff, q.nodisp FROM q FULL JOIN c ON q.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(q.mine,0)-coalesce(c.ctrl,0))>0.5 OR q.nodisp>0 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
lines AS (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM lines f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
yr AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, sum(n.net_sales) net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25, round(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),1) growth_pct
FROM yr ty JOIN yr ly ON ly.region=ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' ORDER BY 1
